amendment: 2026-10-06 user requested one inference per case/version instead of five. Prospective only; retain v1/v2 and historical reports. No budget, model, effort, output-cap, candidate-count or case-set changes.

voting.majority: Single observed action, NOT majority evidence
voting.consistency: null: repeat consistency cannot be estimated with one observation
voting.incomplete_or_unstable: Missing responses block selection; no repetition or automatic resend. Stability is not estimated in single-pass mode.

selection.interpretation: Counts may identify an exploratory candidate for manual review only, not repeated stability, significance, generalization or rollout performance. Historical round1 remains supplementary and is not prospectively rescored into a new winner.
